title: fix: resolve NoneType crash when SKU does not exist
author: dev_alex
diff:
@@ -31,3 +31,5 @@ class InventoryService:
     async def get_stock(session: AsyncSession, sku: str) -> int:
         item = await session.get(InventoryRecord, sku)
-        return item.stock
+        if not item:
+            return 0
+        return item.stock
description: Handles missing inventory rows cleanly instead of letting an unhandled AttributeError bubble up to callers.

title: feat: introduce atomic row locking on stock reservations
author: lead_marcus
diff:
@@ -19,5 +19,10 @@ class InventoryService:
-        result = await session.execute(select(InventoryRecord).where(InventoryRecord.sku == sku))
+        result = await session.execute(
+            select(InventoryRecord)
+            .where(InventoryRecord.sku == sku)
+            .with_for_update()
+        )
         item = result.scalar_one_or_none()
         if not item or item.stock < quantity:
             return False
description: Mitigates high-concurrency race condition and double-spending by acquiring database row locks during inventory checkout.

title: refactor: replace float math with Decimal for order totals
author: dev_sara
diff:
@@ -12,4 +12,5 @@ from decimal import Decimal
-        total_amount = sum(item.quantity * item.unit_price for item in request.items)
+        total_amount = sum(Decimal(str(item.quantity)) * Decimal(str(item.unit_price)) for item in request.items)
+        total_amount = float(round(total_amount, 2))
description: Fixes financial precision drift in basket totals across multi-item checkout flows.

title: fix: add bounded exponential backoff to payment gateway calls
author: dev_alex
diff:
@@ -20,4 +20,9 @@ class PaymentGatewayClient:
-        while True:
+        for attempt in range(settings.max_retries):
             try:
                 resp = await client.post(...)
-            except httpx.RequestError:
+            except httpx.RequestError as exc:
+                if attempt == settings.max_retries - 1:
+                    raise RuntimeError('Gateway unreachable') from exc
+                await asyncio.sleep(2 ** attempt)
description: Prevents infinite token/CPU burn by capping HTTP retry attempts and applying exponential backoff.
